A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MAPLE paper. All 18 pages, including equations, Tables 1-6, Figures 1-9, references, and Appendices A-E, are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original MAPLE retrieval experiments and ablations in Tables 1-4. Appendix C provides additional sensitivity, caption-sampling, and category-level results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original retrieval experiments, ablations, and supplementary analyses reported in Section 4 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The retriever architecture, preference-data construction, pairwise/listwise RPA losses, contrastive regularization, and expanded negative-pool procedure are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix C.1.

E1.justification: Both versions train on the same curated OpenImage data and evaluate on COCO, Flickr30K, Winoground, NaturalBench, MMVP, and BiVLC. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including CLIP, OpenCLIP, SigLIP, SigLIPv2, EVA-CLIP, E5-V, and VladVA in Table 1, and Qwen2-VL-7B in Table 4.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain identical data processing, model sizes, training settings, evaluation metrics, and sample counts, including the 100-instance Winoground subset used for modality-gap measurement.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendices C/E retain the same loss-component and negative-pool ablations, lambda sensitivity analysis, training trajectories, caption-sampling comparison, category breakdowns, and retrieval examples.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither adds experimental run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative findings match throughout. For example, Table 1 reports identical MAPLE-Qwen2-VL-7B COCO text/image R@1 values of 75.5/60.3 and Winoground text/image scores of 56.0/32.7.

T1.justification: The Wasserstein modality-gap definition and reasoning, DPO simplification, and alignment and training equations (1)-(10) are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about inherent MLLM alignment, the unified modality-gap metric, MAPLE preference learning, and improved fine-grained retrieval.

C2.justification: Interpretations of listwise alignment, contrastive regularization, and the general-versus-fine-grained retrieval trade-off are identical. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning MLLM biases and further validation on composed retrieval.

D1.justification: Appendix B and Table 5 provide identical curation instructions, prompts, LoRA settings, hyperparameters, hardware, and training-time information. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: Appendix D and all 42 references match. The positioning relative to contrastive retrieval, MLLM-based retrievers, and preference optimization is unchanged.

P1.justification: The visible arXiv stamp changes from v1, 8 Jun 2025 to v2, 21 Sep 2025. The prose, terminology, section sequence, and appendix structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-9 and Tables 1-6 retain their content, captions, organization, and placement. Visual inspection confirms the same page layouts; negligible rendering differences do not alter the displays.

improvement.justification: Beyond the updated version/date stamp and negligible rendering differences, the main text and appendices are unchanged. The scientific evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations therefore show no meaningful net difference in paper quality.
